notes.title: Patch 0.7.1
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Axle grease removed: the aim speed buff did not provide much benefit
[*] New Upgrade: French Gunpowder: Increases the force with which cannonballs are shot
[*] All upgrades now cost coins in addition to gems
[*] All upgrades have increased coin and gem costs for higher levels!
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed mouse not being unlocked when game is won or lost
[/list]

notes.title: Release Alpha 0.6
notes.content:
Here is a new patch for Booty Barrage.

This patch brings various sweeping changes such as:
[list]
[*] Enemies will now shoot at you to do damage instead of merely ending at a certain spot
[*] Enemies have weak-spots, shoot these to do extra damage!
[*] A new level is now available. Try your luck at Plunder Port!
[*] Tons of bugs fixes
[*] A bunch of new bugs introduced no doubt.
[/list]
